==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=PDFium&min=PDFium&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/PDFiumTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=PDFium&min=PDFium&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
// Verify.PDFium: Verifies pdf documents through PDFium: page sizes, extracted text, a normalized pdf and a png per page.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.PDFium
// Note: The samples read sample.pdf from the output directory. Add the file to the test project
// with a None Update item and CopyToOutputDirectory=PreserveNewest.
// Note: VerifyPDFium.Initialize(dpi: 150) in the module initializer, before InitializePlugins(),
// changes the render resolution. The default 96 dpi renders an A4 page at 794 x 1123.
// Note: Renders are byte identical for a given Morph.PDFium version on every machine and OS, and
// no image library is added.
// Note: Each verification emits an info txt, a pdf and one png per page, so the snapshot count
// grows quickly for a long document.
// Note: ExcludePdfDocument() and SkipPdfNormalization() exist only in the fluent form here; the
// other pdf plugins also ship VerifySettings overloads.
// Note: SkipPdfNormalization is defined in the VerifyTests namespace by several pdf plugins, so
// referencing two of them makes the fluent call ambiguous (CS0121).
// Note: The package targets net10.0 only, and the native PDFium binaries arrive with Morph.PDFium
// for Windows, Linux and macOS.
public class PDFiumTests
{
    // A pdf writes three kinds of target: an info file with the page count, sizes, text and
    // document properties, a normalized .verified.pdf, and one png per rendered page.
    // Not run by default: needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.
    [Fact(Skip = "needs a sample.pdf in the test project, copied to the output directory.")]
    public Task Pdf()
    {
        return VerifyFile("sample.pdf");
    }
}
